name: expected-policy-differs
description: The record is internally consistent: bundle_hash is the correct digest of the bundle policy_uri resolves to. That bundle is a different policy from the one the verifier expects. Run without the expected policy hash, this record passes TR-POL-003, so the expectation is the only thing that fails it.
defect: correct digest over a policy other than the expected one

anchor.text: 5. Policy hash matches the policy bundle the verifier expects.
anchor.applies: The expected bundle is verifier context, supplied to the runner as an expected policy hash and never read from the record. A record whose bundle_hash correctly describes the bundle at policy_uri still fails when that bundle is not the one the verifier expects.

expected.reason: A matching bundle_hash shows the resolved bytes are the ones the record cited, not that they are the policy the verifier expected.
